lines.text: Halt! Who goes there? Friend or foe? Speak, or taste my steel!
Ho there, traveller! Sir Cadogan, at your service!
Flee, then, coward! Ha! Run home to your mother!
Farewell, brave squire! Return when you seek glory!
Darkness! A perfect hour for an ambush. Light a torch, squire, quickly!
I cannot see the enemy! Bring light, I say, bring light!
Ha! Light! The foe is routed!
Well done, squire! Now I can see whom to fight.
Have at thee, foul green knave! Charge!
A hissing green devil! Stand and fight, you cowardly shrub!
Come, knave! Cross swords with me, if you dare!
Another foul beast! Squire, fetch my lance!
You dare strike a knight of the realm? Draw your weapon, villain!
Ha! Is that all you've got? My pony hits harder than that!
Cannon fire! To arms! To arms!
Ha! A mere firecracker! I have survived far worse, I tell you!
Rain! A knight fears no weather!
Mud and rain. Perfect conditions for a charge!
Thunder! The heavens themselves call me to battle!
Do you hear that? The skies applaud my courage!
You're wounded, brave squire! Rest, then return to the fray!
Only a scratch! A true knight bleeds bravely. Now eat something!
A wand? Bah! A true knight fights with steel!
Put away that twig and draw a proper sword!
A fellow swordsman! Have at thee! En garde!
Ha! A blade! Come, let us see your footwork!
Onward, to glory! Ha! Hah! Hah! Hah! Whoa, whoa!
Ha! Hah! Feel my blade, you invisible foe!
Dawn! A new day for glory!
Up, squire! The sun rises, and so must we!
Night falls. I shall stand watch!
Off to bed, squire. I shall guard the gate. I am not sleepy. Not at all.
A Gryffindor! A brave heart! My comrade in arms!
Red and gold! The colours of the bold!
A serpent! Show your fangs, villain, I am ready for you!
Green and silver. I shall be watching you, sneaky one.
A Ravenclaw! Clever, eh? But can you outwit a sword?
A Hufflepuff! Loyal and true! You would make a fine squire.
